title: iRacing GR86 Zandvoort National Guide 1:17.2 Toyota GR86 Zandvoort Track Guide

corners.braking: brake up to almost 90% at 100 board, down to second gear
corners.line: roll on to brakes, apex in second gear, exit wide
corners.exit: back on gas at apex, exit wide

corners.braking: brake to 25-30% at end of left curbing
corners.gear: third gear, drop to second gear
corners.line: brake early, apex in third gear, drop to second gear

corners.braking: roll up to almost 100%, drop to first gear
corners.line: brake early, apex in first gear

corners.gear: drop it down to first, short shift up to second
corners.exit: exit nice and wide, use all camber
corners.mistakes: get your wheel over that curb

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: 1 car length before curbing, 30% to apex

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: braking marker where track drops, 35% to apex
corners.line: point car at end of green asphalt
turn-in to right-hand down, 200° of right-hand down
corners.exit: get back on briefly up to 100%

corners.label: T7
corners.line: right tires on curb or right of curb

corners.braking: brakes briefly two car lengths before white line, 30% trail off
corners.gear: downshift to first, short shift up to second
corners.mistakes: miss going in the strip gravel trap

general_tips: final bit of braking just before this white line on the brakes only to about 30%
exit nice and wide and then we go down using all this camber
